newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to hold extra meeting on sugar crop plan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to hold extra meeting on sugar crop plan.

text.p: Technicians meeting to discuss a Brazilian sugar crop plan will have a further session on April 25 after making some progress in talks today, an official at the Industry and Commerce Ministry said.
"We made some progress and we have scheduled a final reunion for April 25 to analyze all the figures," said Pedro Cabral, head of the sugar and alcohol department at the ministry.

States have been asked to submit figures for alcohol, sugar cane and sugar production. Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso and Sao Paulo handed in their data earlier, but the Sao Paulo figures were global and did not contain a breakdown, Cabral said.
The government hopes to have a sugar crop plan ready by the end of the month, ahead of the official start of harvesting in the centre-south in May.
